news.title: Microsoft confirms 28 Oct report; Alphabet estimated for the same day
news.body: On 7 Oct Microsoft announced it will publish fiscal 2027 first-quarter results after the close on Wednesday 28 Oct. Alphabet has not confirmed a date; earnings calendars estimate 28 Oct after the close, based on past schedules. Both sit in the MAG7 theme, so a shared report day is one event for the theme: a -10% gap in both costs $14,364 against a $6,000 theme cap, and stops do not protect through a scheduled report.
news.src: Microsoft press release via Finviz, 7 Oct 2026 (https://finviz.com/news/400058/microsoft-announces-quarterly-earnings-release-date); GOOGL date per nextearningsdate.com and Wall Street Horizon, read 12 Oct (https://www.nextearningsdate.com/alphabet.html, https://www.wallstreethorizon.com/alphabet-earnings-calendar)

news.title: EIA: 85 Bcf injection; surplus to the five-year average narrows to 68 Bcf
news.body: For the week to 2 Oct the EIA reported an 85 Bcf net injection. Working gas reached 3,500 Bcf: 68 Bcf (2.0%) above the five-year average of 3,432 Bcf, down from 79 Bcf a week earlier, and 130 Bcf (3.6%) below a year ago. Next report: Thu 15 Oct.
news.src: EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report, released 8 Oct 2026 (https://ir.eia.gov/ngs/ngs.html)

news.body: CRM 300 was bought on 9 Oct at 230.00 through a buy stop-limit, with a 220 protective stop. notes: NAV is $300,000 throughout - the notional mandate assigned by the firm. Never measured against account equity, by instruction. 1% = $3,000.
Limits are provisional, set 15 Sep 2026: 2% maximum loss per theme, 6% across the portfolio. Not a written company risk policy.
Themes are assigned, not fed. IBKR returns no sector tags; every theme in this file is a stated assumption. CRM's theme (Enterprise software) is the one it carried when last held in September.

Stop distances are shown as probability of being touched over a holding period, not in daily sigma - these are GTC orders with no expiry. The probability is the reflection-principle first-passage estimate 2*Phi(-ln(S/B)/(sigma*sqrt(T))) on realised daily vol, zero drift.

Stops are the account's GTC working orders, read through the IBKR connector when the board is refreshed in session; the unattended daily run carries the last read forward, because an IBKR Activity Flex Query cannot report working orders. Where a position has more than one stop, the nearest one drives the touch probabilities and the dollar risk sums every tranche. Still unconfirmed: whether they are enabled outside regular trading hours - most gaps occur overnight, which is exactly when a stop is least likely to help.

Scenario betas: UNG ~1.0 to front-month gas; MSFT and GOOGL 1.0 to mega-cap tech; CRM 1.0 to enterprise software. Broad-market betas are 60-bar OLS on SPX, 2026-07-17 to 2026-10-09: CRM 0.68, GOOGL 1.34, MSFT 2.05. MSFT's is inflated by its +15.5% post-results day on 30 Jul, which rolls off the window around 23 Oct. CRM's fit is weak (correlation 0.12) and its window includes its +22.6% post-results day on 27 Aug - treat its row as indicative. Only MSFT breaches its stop in the broad-market row (-6.15% takes it to 502.16 against the 510 stop); GOOGL (-4.01% against a stop 4.74% below) and CRM (-2.05% against 3.98%) take their full moves. UNG's market beta is negative (-0.25) and no hedge credit is taken for it.

Scenario, slippage and gap figures are authored at the prices in price_basis (9 Oct regular-session closes) against the positions in basis_book and do not move with the market. The tab flags them when prices drift past tolerance or the book changes.

The MAG7 theme is over its cap on stops alone: MSFT $3,435 + GOOGL $3,332 = $6,767 of stop risk against the $6,000 theme limit (113%). That is down from 173% on 7 Oct, after META stopped out on 8 Oct and MSFT's stop was raised from 491 to 510. That is the limit set on 15 Sep, measured as written; resolving it is the account owner's call, not the board's.

Stops do not protect through a scheduled report. MSFT reports on 28 Oct (confirmed 7 Oct) and GOOGL is estimated for the same day (unconfirmed). MSFT moved 15.5% in a day on 30 Jul after its last report; a -10% gap in both would cost $14,364, 239% of the theme cap. The gap rows use the -10% scenario, so they are not the worst case.

Rates +50bp: 3-year regressions (n=756) of daily returns on daily ^TNX changes in bp. Only GOOGL has a negative slope (-0.0048%/bp, t -0.37, not significant) => -0.24%; MSFT (+0.022, t 1.97), CRM (+0.010, t 0.61) and UNG (+0.020, t 0.81) get no credit. The row also extrapolates a daily slope linearly to a cumulative 50bp move, and excludes TLT (900 shares), which remains the main rate exposure in this account - it falls when yields rise.
Independently reviewed. The first issue (15 Sep 2026) was blocked and reissued; the 27 Sep, 3 Oct, 7 Oct and 12 Oct re-derivations were each reviewed the same way before publishing.

Book changes since 7 Oct, from the IBKR trade blotter (get_account_trades, 7 days) read 12 Oct: on 8 Oct three GTC stop orders filled - FPS 1,000 at 39.15-39.23 (realised -$1,659.57) and SOXL 120 at 142 (realised -$1,442.35) - both on stops raised after the 7 Oct read (38.50 and 129) - and META 100 at 712.78 (realised -$2,796.85); on 9 Oct CRM opened 300 @ 230.00 via a buy stop-limit entry with its 220 stop staged in advance. MSFT's stop was raised 491 -> 510, above its 498.87 average entry, and UNG's two 9.35 tranches became a single 3,000-share order (both amended 8 Oct). A pending entry order that has not filled is not on the board. Earlier: on 6 Oct MSFT was trimmed 200 -> 137, UNG added 1,000 @ 10.70, FPS and GOOGL opened; GOOGL and GNRC stopped out 23 Sep, SMCI 24 Sep, CRM 25 Sep, SNOW 28 Sep.

Parametric VaR sits above this window's history: the historical 5th percentile loss is $4,487 against a parametric 95% figure of $6,786, because the volatility estimate includes large up-days. That is a sample property, not safety - 60 days is a short tail sample. The worst day for today's holdings in the window was $9,190 on 2026-07-23, 0.96x the 99% VaR.

One day drives the 60-bar statistics for CRM, MSFT: CRM +22.6% on 2026-08-27 (daily vol 3.86%, 2.57% without it; rolls off about 2026-11-20); MSFT +15.5% on 2026-07-30 (daily vol 2.52%, 1.59% without it; rolls off about 2026-10-23). Vol, beta, VaR and touch odds all fall when each leaves the window - a lower reading then is the window rolling, not risk falling, and it can land just before the next report.

Pairwise correlations over the window: CRM-GOOGL +0.23; CRM-MSFT +0.09; CRM-UNG -0.10; GOOGL-MSFT +0.35; GOOGL-UNG -0.00; MSFT-UNG -0.08. With 60 observations each carries a standard error near 0.13, so treat any value inside about +/-0.26 as indistinguishable from zero, and a negative one as no dependable hedge. Taking no credit for the negative ones lifts 99% VaR from $9,595 to $9,755.
